panels.rationale: Single axial brain image (appears T2-weighted MRI despite caption's 'CT scan' wording, given bright CSF and gray-white differentiation) of a real patient, with red arrows marking markedly enlarged lateral ventricles and prominent trigone. Ventriculomegaly is a recognized neuroradiological feature of Sotos syndrome and is present in the allowed vocabulary (sotos_syndrome_cerebral_ventriculomegaly), and the disease-focused article title ('Biotinidase Deficiency With Suspected Sotos Syndrome: A Rare Entity') together with the in-text growth-spurt history supports attributing the captioned ventriculomegaly/megalencephaly manifestation to Sotos syndrome. Megalencephaly itself is clearly captioned but absent from the vocabulary, so it is placed in proposed_findings. No ethnicity or explicit age is stated; confidence is moderate because the article's primary diagnosis is biotinidase deficiency with Sotos syndrome only suspected.
